method: Read every defined system and independently reconstruct expected noun/adjective/verb morphology from the directly viewed primary rules and lexical entries. Check each canonical cell and each literal/model-derived display coordinate against that reconstruction; inspect quantity, exceptions and scope. This preliminary result does not accept nonexistent learner/key prose.

scope_findings: All22 nominal NGDA paradigms and14 adjective systems are complete within their defined26-position scope. Instrumental masculine/neuter singular cells are recognition reference, with other instrumental uses explicitly syncretic.
Gehīersumnes/ręst plural cells are morphological recognition reference; no new abstract count sense follows.
Hęre/sciphęre expansion variants, fōte/fōtas, fēonde/fīend variants, wǣp(e)n/wǣpnu and ēadig optional syncope must remain visible in actual learner.
Strong preterite second singular uses plural stem: ādrife and fluge have short root vowel. Gehēt retains long ē, gemētte/grētte retain ē; cȳðde alternatives are acknowledged.
Nine command pairs and two infinitive pairs assign only their stated systems; no new subjunctive paradigm is implied.

Gewyrcende/geworht, gierwende/gierwed and sęttende/sętt are productive bases with bounded syntax; gewītende/gewiten and sittende/seten remain recognition. No complete new participial adjective system is silently assigned.
The twelve habban positions reuse actual prior indicative identities and a separately assigned perfect sense; reported hæfde must retain its distinct prior subjunctive identity.

BT497a/493a directly support both bare and object-agreeing participles; finite subject agreement differs from participle-object agreement. Causatives and unrestricted intransitive have-perfects are excluded.

resolved_queries.finding: Cook Exercise21.9 explicitly gives rest with ręst51.b as lexical hint. Glossary309 alone has couch/bed, but the assigned exercise directly supports the bounded abstract sense.
